summary: Retest of the GET /api/auditpro/invoices ledger bug fix (sort tiebreaker [('issue_date',-1),('_id',-1)] + cap raised 100->500). Reran the two previously-failing backend tests (test_tscheck_invoice_finalize_field.py, test_tscheck_invoice_creation.py) -- both now pass. Reran the full pre-existing backend suite (46 tests) for regression: only the 3 known-flaky live-Gemini OCR tests failed (out of scope per spec_deviations, confirmed non-deterministic by a focused rerun where 1 of 3 flipped to pass). Reran all 7 persisted Fase-1/ledger-adjacent browser checks by name -- all pass. GET /api/auditpro/invoices now returns 203 rows (cap confirmed raised above 100), consistent with the fix.

action_items.note: tests/test_tscheck_document_extraction.py, test_tscheck_document_validation.py, test_tscheck_duplicate_detection.py intermittently fail with 502 'Gemini tidak dapat memproses dokumen ini' on the live Gemini OCR call (full-suite run: all 3 failed; focused rerun: 1 of 3 passed). Matches spec_deviations ('Document OCR ... can intermittently 502 on first attempt — out of scope for this retest'). No application code issue identified; purely upstream LLM latency/availability.

checks.evidence: POST /api/auditpro/invoices finalize=false -> 200 status=draft; finalize=true -> 200 status=pending. Both now found in GET /api/auditpro/invoices (previously failed on the 100-row cap/no-tiebreaker bug; now passes with sort [('issue_date',-1),('_id',-1)] and cap=500). 2 passed.
